title: Algebraic complexes computing local homology
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $B$ a commutative ring, $R$ a commutative ring sheaf on the small pro-etale site, and $\phi:\underline B\to R$ a coefficient map. Use the actual constant realization of [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data], including its universe lift and ordinary scalar extension along $\phi$; call this additive functor $C$. For $K\in D(R)$, an etale chart $V$, and integers $a,b$, define the local homology model predicate as follows. For every etale $W\to V$ there is a covering sieve $S$ on $W$ such that for each $Z\to W$ in $S$ there is an algebraic cochain complex $P$ of $B$-modules, with $P^i=0$ outside $[a,b]$ and all $P^i$ finitely generated, and for every integer $q$ an isomorphism $H^q(K)|_Z\cong C(H^q(P))|_Z$. This definition imposes no separate finite-generation condition on algebraic homology and no global vanishing condition on the slice over $V$.
